text: DSH Client UI Shortcuts（DSH Web 插件）：在浏览器中查看和管理 DSH 官方快捷键。它把快捷键面板接入页面覆盖层和插件设置，并使用官方快捷键服务读取和修改命令绑定。用户可以搜索命令、录制或清除绑定、查看冲突，并导入或导出配置；还可选择启用问题和审批交互的键盘控制。适合希望集中管理 Web 快捷键并改善提问或审批操作的用户。无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Client UI Shortcuts manages official keyboard shortcuts in DSH Web. Its panel supports command search, shortcut recording and clearing, conflict review, and JSON import or export. Optional keyboard controls support question and approval interactions. No API key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH Web 里搜索并修改命令快捷键。
我想录制新的按键组合，也能清除旧绑定。
如何把快捷键配置导出备份，之后再导入？
想让提问时可以用键盘切换和提交选项。
审批工具请求时能否用键盘选择允许或拒绝？
I want a searchable panel to change my DSH Web keyboard shortcuts.
Can I export my shortcut setup and import it on another setup?
I want keyboard controls for answering questions and approvals.
DSH Client UI Shortcuts 的功能「管理 DSH 命令快捷键」：面板列出官方命令及当前绑定，可搜索命令并录制、清除或重置按键。通过快捷键面板操作。
DSH Client UI Shortcuts 的功能「导入和导出快捷键」：将当前配置下载为 JSON 文件，也可选择 JSON 文件导入配置。
DSH Client UI Shortcuts 的功能「键盘操作提问和审批」：分别启用后，在对话交互区域用方向键移动焦点、Enter 激活、Escape 取消任务。

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · DSH Client UI Shortcuts：DSH owns keybindings: the plugin registers one editable official command and keeps no key store and no second shortcut configuration. It does not modify DSH core, the agent loop, or the model protocol.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Install in 60 seconds：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts@0.2.1
dsh --profile web
```

Reload the Web composition after installing or upgrading; an already open page is not hot-updated. See the [installation guide](docs/installation.md) for the full flow.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Quick launch：The plugin registers one official command, **Open quick panel**, with these default keys:

| Platform | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Web / macOS | `⌘⌥⇧S` |
| Web / Windows | `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+S` |
| Web / Linux | No default (the official allowed set is narrower there) |

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Quick launch：The panel shows the current official binding, record / change / restore-default / clear controls, the two enhancement switches, and an open button. The Plugins-page entry also opens it, so it stays reachable even when the command is unbound or conflicting.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Search and rebinding：The search field above the shortcut list filters it by command name, command id, or keycap. It only affects what is shown and never changes what is saved.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Rebinding in the panel：Conflicts, unsupported keys, stale configuration, read failures, and write failures each show their own message. The same command can also be changed in **DSH Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts**; both surfaces stay in sync.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Configuration import and export：| `modified` in the file | Current state | Import action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `true` | — | Write the override; `binding: null` clears that key |
| `false` | overridden | Restore the official default |
| `false` | untouched | Leave it alone |

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Configuration import and export：An import is strictly validated first (format, version, exact field sets, command ids, physical codes and modifiers; unknown fields and future versions are refused wholesale, capped at 1 MiB), then planned against the whole target snapshot: keys the file moves or clears are released before the target values are written through the official `describeBinding()` and `edit()`, so swapping two bindings restores correctly. Both switches commit in one atomic write. The official `edit()` has no batch transaction, so a mid-import failure is rolled back on a best-effort basis and any command still unrestored is listed instead of reporting success. A refused or conflicting official edit never writes the plugin switches. Export normalizes the logical `primary` modifier to the device's real `meta`/`control`, so importing an export and exporting again is byte-identical. See the [integration notes (Chinese)](docs/official-shortcuts-integration.zh.md) for format details and limits.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Optional interaction enhancements：Both switches default to **off** and take over nothing until enabled:

| Switch | Behavior when enabled |
| --- | --- |
| Enhanced question interaction | Arrow-key selection, `Enter` confirmation, `Escape` task cancellation |
| Enhanced approval interaction | Keyboard selection of "Allow once" or "Reject"; it never grants approval automatically |

`Enter` always activates the focused action: after moving focus to "Reject", `Enter` rejects instead of reusing the previous selection.
@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Compatibility：See the [integration notes (Chinese)](docs/official-shortcuts-integration.zh.md).

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Development and verification：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run bundle
pnpm exec vitest run tests

Browser acceptance must run through a real DSH Web composition on `0.2.0-rc.1`; the `apps/web` Vite entry is not a validation target for this plugin.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Does this change model behavior?：No. The plugin changes browser interaction only. It adds no tools, prompt sections, model-visible events, or model request context.

@hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Why does the shortcut not work?：Check the default table above for your platform (Linux Web has no default binding), then inspect the command in **DSH Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts** or in the plugin panel for a rebind, a cleared binding, or a conflict. The panel entry button always works.
section: Why does the shortcut not work?

text: @hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Does rebinding in the plugin panel affect DSH settings?：They cannot overwrite each other: both surfaces read and write the same official configuration.
section: Does rebinding in the plugin panel affect DSH settings?

text: @hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts README · Can I use it without DSH Web?：No. The browser artifact is a DSH loader factory and depends on DSH boot injection, slots, locale, settings, and the official shortcuts service.
section: Can I use it without DSH Web?
